# Baeshen Medical Complex (مجمع باعشن الطبي)

> CBAHI-accredited private medical complex in Sabya, Jazan (Saudi Arabia). Specialist clinics, in-house pharmacy with delivery, telemedicine, home care, and online booking.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of Baeshen Medical Complex — specialist care in Sabya, Jazan.
- [About](/about): Mission, accreditation, and leadership of the complex.
- [The Complex](/complex): Facility tour — clinics, pharmacy, and amenities.
- [Branches](/branches): All Baeshen Medical branches and locations.
- [Specialties](/specialties): Medical specialties offered (internal medicine, pediatrics, OB-GYN, dentistry, ophthalmology, and more).
- [Doctors](/doctors): Consultants and specialists directory.
- [Book Appointment](/book): Book an appointment with a doctor online.
- [Packages](/packages): Preventive and check-up packages.
- [Telemedicine](/telemedicine): Remote consultations with our doctors.
- [Home Care](/home-care): In-home nursing and medical services.
- [Pharmacy](/pharmacy): Order and deliver medications in Sabya and Jazan.
- [Insurance](/insurance): Accepted insurance providers.
- [International Patients](/international-patients): Services for international patients.
- [Emergency](/emergency): Emergency contact and services.
- [Health Library](/health): Health articles and patient education.
- [News](/media/news): Latest news from Baeshen Medical.

- [Contact](/contact): Phone, WhatsApp, email, and address.

- [Complaints](/complaints): Submit a complaint or feedback.
